name: Cowboy Duel VR: Red Wild West Massacre
summary:
Step into a world where revolvers make the law and duels decide your fate. In Cowboy Duel VR: Red Wild West Massacre, become a legendary gunslinger and face ruthless outlaws in high-stakes showdowns. Choose a charismatic character and test your skill in duels where every shot counts.
